display_long_description:
# Swing your racket to the beat!
I took the badminton mod from Beat Saber and turned it into a full rhythm game! Experience flow as you swing, smash, and return volleys to the beat of 10+ soundtracks.
[media]
[media]

# Work up a sweat!
Just 4 note types and 3 lanes combine to create complex patterns.
[media]
[media]

# 10+ soundtracks to play!
With more on the way!
[media]

# Audience reacts to your performance!
Watch the audience cheer in excitement during perfect swings.
[media]

# Aim for a Million!
Aim for a max score of 1,000,000 on each soundtrack to earn M rank.
[media]

# Discover artists with banger tracks!
From rhythm game artists like **t+pazolite** (Arcaea, DEEMO, & Cytus II) and **Nstryder** (osu!, Geometry Dash, & Sound Space).
[media]

# Features
What Rhythm Racket offers:
- **10+ soundtracks** with more in development
- **Variety of genres**, including EDM, rock, artcore, and more
- Discover artists with banger tracks
- **Work up a sweat**
- Timing-based judgment
- Accessibility: Left handed mode and adjustable hit locations
